name: Dimitrios Katsaros
bio:
Dimitrios's journey into motorsport began not on the track, but within the immersive world of video games. A prodigious talent in sim racing from a young age, he quickly identified the potential for simulators to revolutionize driver training and vehicle development. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics and control systems, while simultaneously building his own advanced racing simulator in his spare time. His passion and ingenuity caught the eye of Caterham Motorsport, who brought him on board to refine their simulator program.

Dimitrios approaches his role with a blend of technical expertise and creative problem-solving. He's not just interested in replicating reality; he strives to anticipate future trends and incorporate cutting-edge technologies into the simulator environment. He believes that the simulator should be a laboratory for innovation, where drivers and engineers can push the boundaries of performance without real-world consequences.

What distinguishes Dimitrios is his visionary mindset and his relentless pursuit of improvement. He’s always exploring new ways to enhance the realism and effectiveness of the simulator, whether it's through advanced data analysis, novel control algorithms, or cutting-edge hardware integrations. His dedication makes him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: A man of medium build, Dimitrios has a focused gaze that reflects his intense concentration.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with circuit diagrams and technical notes.
Has a habit of humming softly while calibrating the simulator.
Insists on drinking only Greek coffee during race simulations.
